    inp_path=saved_path.with_name(saved_path.name.replace(".answer.json",".input.json"))
    inp=read(inp_path)
    assert inp["messages"]==messages and inp["schema"]==schema
    assert inp["playbook_sha256"]==csha(book) and inp["delivered_bullet_ids"]==list(bullets(book))
    assert inp["TRAIN_only"] is True and inp["future_or_TEST_feedback_available"] is False
    assert inp["current_TRAIN_reflection_available"]==(reflection is not None)
    raw=read(root/saved["raw_call_path"])
    assert raw["response"] is not None and len(raw["calls"])==1
    native[saved["raw_call_path"]]=raw
    http=raw["calls"][0]["response"];response=raw["response"]
    choice=http["choices"][0]
    assert choice["message"]["content"]==response["content"] and choice["finish_reason"]==response["finish_reason"]
    assert http["id"]==response["raw_id"]
    assert http["usage"]["prompt_tokens"]==response["prompt_tokens"] and http["usage"]["completion_tokens"]==response["completion_tokens"]
    request=raw["calls"][0]["request"]
    assert request["messages"]==messages and request["response_format"]["json_schema"]["schema"]==schema
    for k in ("temperature","top_p","top_k","max_tokens","seed","model"):
        assert request[k]==cfg["generation"][k],(key,stage,k)
    value=decoded=used=rationale=error=None
    try:
        if raw["response"]["finish_reason"]!="stop":
            raise ValueError("Incomplete native ACE output: "+str(raw["response"]["finish_reason"]))
        value=json.loads(raw["response"]["content"]);validate(value,schema)
        used,rationale=copy.deepcopy(value["bullet_ids"]),value["reasoning"]
        decoded=decode_generator(row,book,value,direct_numeric=True,asset_references=True)
    except (ValueError,ValidationError) as exc:error=repr(exc)
    assert saved["parse_error"]==error
    assert saved.get("unparsed_public_output")==(raw["response"]["content"] if error else None)
    assert saved.get("native_finish_reason")==(raw["response"]["finish_reason"] if error else None)
    if error:
        failed_public_texts.append({"case":key[0],"family":key[1],"stage":stage,"public_characters":len(saved["unparsed_public_output"]),
                                  "original_failure_retained":True,"native_F1":evaluate(row,None,gold[key[0]][key[1]])["f1"]})
    assert saved["actual_wrapper_submission"]==value
    assert saved["used_bullet_ids"]==used and saved["public_rationale"]==rationale
    assert saved["parsed"]==(None if decoded is None else {"answer":decoded["answer"]})
    assert saved["native_program"] is None and saved["execution_receipt"] is None
    if used is not None and len(used)!=len(set(used)):
        raw_id_repetitions.append({"case":key[0],"family":key[1],"stage":stage,"raw_IDs":used,"legal_parse_error":error})
    answer=(saved.get("parsed") or {}).get("answer") if error is None else None
    score=evaluate(row,answer,gold[key[0]][key[1]])
    if "score" in record:assert csha(score)==csha(record["score"])
    saved["score"]=score
    members.update(str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in (saved_path,inp_path))
    members.add(saved["raw_call_path"])
    return saved
